title: Hom3Page
tagline: Home3page is the home of web3. A decentralised wall of interactive web3 blocks that connects the web3 ecosystem and community.
description:
The Hom3 Wall is a communication and marketing hub for Web 3 projects, vetted through the power of the Blockchain. The Wall will reside within our application and can also be integrated into various web3 platforms including The Metaverse.

We are building 
1) a central hub for web3 users to find engagement-rich and web3-specific content and applications 
2) a decentralised application network & standard that allows for open interoperable dApps
3) A wall of dApps owned and curated by the community

It has two main features.  The Wall and the bApp.  The wall is our community-led canvas that can be bought and populated by users.  The bApps are the underlying products that can be interactive, portable between environments & create a frictionless experience for the user.

The wall will feature programmable blocks built, owned, and governed by the community. Each ERC-721 block can be edited to become an abstract, launch pad, or entire sector of web3. Each block can be filled with prebuilt or community-based apps, or as we call them bApp's, including static text, images, or custom interactive apps with different hosting and connection abilities, build a game in your block!

The unique combination of blocks will be an ever-evolving display of web3 with its own underlying economy. Hom3page will feature a block app marketplace & advertising network and be at the forefront of web3 technology building always with interoperability in the front and center.

Hom3Page has a place and utility for NFT Degen’s, DeFi Ape’s, Web3 Brands and Crypto-X shit posters.  It will be an ever-evolving display of true web3 with an underlying economy.  What might be a part of this economy?
- Block App Marketplace (https://bapps.hom3page.com/)
- Advertising Network
- Community Lead Content
- Block Renting
how_its_made:
To build this prototype of Hom3Page we have built the basics of the wall and bApp system, with focus on what the bApps could do and how they can be ported.  We have included using CCIP to allows for cross-chain Block purchasing and depositing of funds for your Hom3Profile on Mumbai.  We are using GHO as the payment token on Sepolia with a vault for profile deposits.

Hom3Page is a complex ecosystem that is going to rely on a range of technologies to see it built out to it maximum web3 potential.  We will be employing distributed computing and storage, researching ICP, for bApp storage and rendering.  A framework for users to develop their own bApp and submit for approval.  The wall is being built as a web app utilising Next.js & React working with the ConnectionKit for wallet connections & providers.  

The smart contracts for Hom3Page are quite complex, there are ERC721 & 1155 token standards with custom voter wrappers.  Sales contracts that utilise CCIP for cross-chain purchasing of Blocks.  We have also implemented GHO as the native token for purchasing Blocks & bApps.  We are also developing a 'profile' token for individual user customisation of the wall area, this will include the ability to link with your Lens profile, mint across multiple chains and deploy a cross-chain vault allowing for users to deposit with permits, allowing more efficient transitions between wall bApps and ecosystems.  These could come to have builtin bridges, all built into the wall.
